task: N8-40b public LW route seam rework (n8-seam)

problem.statement: The N8-40 policy-selected region dispatch (cylinder_longwave._lw_region_route -> _lw_dispatch.region_route -> resolve_lw_backend) is gated on the driver's parallel flag; the public pipeline call site computes parallel = get_runtime_options().threads_per_worker > 1, and the DX-pinned default threads_per_worker=1 makes the selector structurally unreachable at the ordinary no-env default. Native can never be the automatic default without a seam change.
problem.driver_gate: cylinder_longwave.py:387 'if parallel and rows*cols:' (single route-consult call site at :388)

confirmed: engine.py:1655 (Solweig_2022a_calc anisotropic branch) is the ONLY public call site that reaches _lw_region_route: Lcyl_v2022a_by_demand (PIPELINE_CYLINDERS_ANISOTROPIC demand, set by pipeline.py:262 for the whole tile loop) -> Lcyl_v2022a_primary -> define_patch_characteristics_primary -> :388 _lw_region_route. This is the site the public pipeline drives every timestep; region/consumers.py:33 names define_patch_characteristics_primary as the sole consumer.

engine.py:1770 (engine.define_patch_characteristics wrapper) and engine.py:1778 (engine.Lcyl_v2022a wrapper) delegate to patch_radiation drivers, which never import cylinder_longwave and contain no route consult point. They cannot reach the region dispatch under ANY demand profile or H value.

Lcyl_v2022a_by_demand has exactly one caller in src: engine.py:1655.
site_verification.brief_correction: The brief classifies :1770 as a cylinder-longwave call site that reaches the LW region dispatch. That is incorrect for this tree: :1770's driver (patch_radiation.define_patch_characteristics) has no region-dispatch consult point, and making it route-eligible would require either (a) a second selector consult path in patch_radiation -- forbidden by hard constraint 3 -- or (b) rerouting the public full-diagnostics drivers through the primary-output driver, which would drop the four cardinal outputs and change shipped public behavior -- forbidden. This is NOT a guardrail conflict that forced a change beyond the brief; it is a factual correction of the site inventory. The default objective is unaffected: the public pipeline's LW cost flows exclusively through :1655, which becomes route-eligible at H=1.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Flip the wrapper to parallel=True unconditionally
rejected_candidates.why_rejected: At H=1 the legacy path would switch from the serial njit kernels (_longwave_primary_serial / _longwave_fused_primary_serial) to the parallel prange variants: different kernel, extra thread usage, nonzero shipped-state delta in threading and code path. Violates shipped-state inertness (hard constraint 1).

rejected_candidates.candidate: Thread the selector consult before the parallel gate at the driver with a serial-preservation flag
rejected_candidates.why_rejected: Requires a new boolean threaded through Lcyl_v2022a_by_demand -> Lcyl_v2022a_primary -> define_patch_characteristics_primary so the driver can distinguish 'explicit parallel=False' from 'wrapper-derived False'. Same effect as the chosen mechanism but with a wider driver surface (a second policy-shaped parameter alongside parallel), and it forks route-eligibility into a flag that callers could set inconsistently with the parallel value. The chosen design achieves the identical distinction inside the existing parameter's value domain with zero new parameters.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Consult the route at the wrapper and pass an explicit route hint down
rejected_candidates.why_rejected: Puts a selector consult (or its result) at the wrapper, creating a second selector consult path and a second place that must replicate the expert-env standdown -- violates hard constraint 3 (single interception point at cylinder_longwave._lw_region_route, no new env reads).

design.chosen_mechanism: Tri-state the parallel value at the existing seam, inside the existing parameter's domain. The wrapper at engine.py:1655 stops deriving a serial demand from H: threads_per_worker > 1 passes parallel=True (explicit parallel demand, byte-identical to today); threads_per_worker <= 1 passes parallel=None (NO explicit demand) instead of False. None is falsy, so every existing falsy-parallel branch in the driver family resolves exactly as parallel=False does today: _lw_kernel(None) -> _longwave_primary_serial, the fused block selector -> _longwave_fused_primary_serial, and the FULL_DIAGNOSTICS path enters patch_radiation normalized to bool(None)=False (patch_radiation stays boolean-domain and untouched). The one and only gate change is in define_patch_characteristics_primary: 'if parallel and rows*cols:' becomes 'if parallel is not False and rows*cols:' -- explicit False keeps the gate shut (driver-level serial demand pinned by test_serial_demand_never_dispatches is preserved verbatim), while None opens it so the EXISTING single consult point (_lw_region_route at :388) fires at H=1.
design.consult_location: Unchanged: cylinder_longwave._lw_region_route (the package's only env-read standdown) -> _lw_dispatch.region_route -> resolve_lw_backend, once per routed driver call. No second consult path, no new env reads, selector taxonomy untouched.
design.new_parameters: None. No signature changes anywhere; the seam reuses the existing parallel keyword's value domain (True / False / None).
design.serial_demand_preservation: Driver-level parallel=False remains the ONLY serial demand: the route gate 'parallel is not False' excludes exactly False, so test_serial_demand_never_dispatches and every sibling keep their exact semantics with zero test edits. The wrapper's H-derived value at H=1 is no longer False, so it is no longer a serial demand -- that is the entire seam.
design.qualified_state_behavior: With an injected qualified row (tests only), the public H=1 call opens the gate, the selector resolves row B/C, and _execute_row dispatches through the one bounded region owner whose threading is its own (BLOCK_FANOUT / self_parallel modes are independent of RuntimeOptions threads_per_worker -- the N8-40 driver-level tests already dispatch under default H=1 options). Row A/absent declines to None and the caller's legacy loop runs unchanged.
design.shipped_state_delta_statement: With the shipped empty registry and no env, the public H=1 call takes the exact legacy serial path as today: bitwise-identical outputs, same serial kernels (_longwave_primary_serial / _longwave_fused_primary_serial), same thread usage (zero extra threads). The ONLY permitted and deliberate delta: exactly one resolve_lw_backend() registry read per public LW driver call -- the N7-fair per-call read already shipped at the driver boundary for H>1 since N8-40 -- plus the import of the vendored policy module inside region_route (pure Python, no execution machinery: an empty registry fails closed to row A before any of it is imported).
design.h_over_1_delta: None. H>1 keeps parallel=True: the gate already consulted at H>1, so shipped H>1 behavior is bit-identical including the existing per-call selector read.
